title: AiObservation billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = AiObservation (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 11. An AI observation is present at or above a confidence. Flag only (I-5): a Reject consequence is refused at publish (task 073). Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

minConfidence.description: Confidence at or above which the observation counts. More than 0, at most 1.
